Activity24h.description: How long the patient spent standing, walking and moving, over a window ending now.

CertaintyValue.description:
One certainty metric for one output.

``score`` is always normalised so that 1.0 is most certain and 0.0 least,
whatever the metric, so any display (percent, badge, bars, opacity) can be
driven by any metric. ``raw`` carries the metric's native values for the
explanation view.
CertaintyValue.title: CertaintyValue

DevicesMessage.description: Sent on connect, on any change, and at least every 5 seconds.

Extreme.description: The highest and lowest of a parameter over a window ending at the chosen minute.

Finding.description: An AI interpretation of what is happening (or happened), with its evidence.

SignalStatus.description:
Why a parameter's number is, or is not, on screen right now.

The display never infers this from a missing value: the server always says
which state applies, so STANDBY, CONNECTION LOST and CHECK SENSOR cannot be
confused with each other or with a blank.
SignalStatus.title: SignalStatus
